```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(respondersig)
```

# Read in data
```{r}
load("../manuscript/data/clinical.rds")
load("../manuscript/data/microbiome_metadata.rds")

taxa <- read.csv("../data/2024-08-30_mpa_aggregated_long.csv")
```

# Format
```{r}
samp.info <- mic.meta %>%
  left_join(demographics) %>%
  select(sample, Response) %>%
  rename("response" = "Response") %>%
  filter(sample %in% taxa$sample)
```

# Try respondersig function 
```{r}
rsig <- respondersig::prepInput(tax = taxa, meta = samp.info, tax.level = "All")
```
